//include: This dir IS the `mote` package (setup.py maps package_dir={mote: .}).
//extraPaths: '.pyright' holds the mote symlink; see //pyright-resolve. Previously '..' but that broke when the checkout dir was renamed away from 'mote'. Lets pyright resolve`mote.*` self-imports via the parent dir.
//pyright-resolve: '.pyright/mote' is an in-repo symlink to the repo root, so pyright resolves mote.* self-imports regardless of the checkout dir name (mote, mote-agent, ...). It is excluded below so the symlink isn't scanned twice.
//pythonVersion: Tracks the actual dev/runtime env (3.11), not the >=3.9 floor in setup.py; 3.9 surfaces ~93 extra 3.10+ syntax errors -- revisit when the 3.9-support question is settled.
//optional-deps: Not installed on purpose; ignore their missing imports. manager.py guards the optional `rag` module behind try/except ImportError -- kept as an optional-feature placeholder, not cleaned.
